newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids remain higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids remain higher.

text.p: Basis bids for dark northern spring wheat remained higher on Wednesday in line with stronger wheat futures on the Minneapolis Grain Exchange.
Farm sales were also slow despite the runup in wheat futures as farmers remained bullish. "They are still holding on to their remaining wheat," a Montana merchandiser said.
In the eastern third of South Dakota, farmers were focusing on spring wheat plantings rather than selling old crop wheat, Minneapolis dealer said.
But in North Dakota, which was plagued by flooding in the Red River Valley region, movement was limited, dealers said.
MGE spring wheat settled 10-1/4 to 13-1/4 cents higher, with May up 10-1/4 cents at $4.43-1/2 per bushel. July gained 13-1/4 cents to $4.48-3/4.
